about.bio: My name is Carlos Ramos, but my friends call me Capi. I started programming with an IBM in school when I was 8 years old. Currently, I'm a trained Full Stack MERN developer.

services.title: Frontend Development
services.desc: I build modern and responsive interfaces with React, CSS and smooth animations.

services.title: UX/UI Design

services.title: Backend & APIs
services.desc: I develop secure REST APIs with Node.js, Express and SQL/NoSQL databases.

experience.title: Junior Full Stack Developer
experience.description: Together with my team and Data Science, we developed a platform with a dashboard and calendar for startups in Valencia, improving UX and reducing load times by 30%.

experience.title: Backend Developer
experience.description: Developed a Node.js + Express.js server and managed SQL databases, optimizing queries and system performance.

experience.title: Junior Developer
experience.description: I designed UI components in React and helped fix bugs to improve the application's stability.

experience.title: Systems Administrator
experience.description: I provided support for the university's equipment, as well as repaired, updated, and created local networks for students.

experience.title: Systems Administrator
